flags.message: The event declares moment=distribution, but context.cutoff and cut_kind are null and snapshot_provenance is as-stored. The supplied snapshot includes two distributions and later briefing rather than a demonstrated first-distribution cut. Both distributions were entered before either scheduled conference (July 22 for September 28; September 16 for October 9), so the count of two is not evidence of a completed conference and true relist. Retained the authoritative sal-v4 elevated band and count, used the supplied record under forward rules, and discounted the deliberative relist inference. No disposition of this petition was retrieved or encountered.
